search.structured.iterations_per_cell.description: Number of search iterations per dimension cell. Higher values find more results but take longer.
search.structured.iterations_per_cell.name: Iterations Per Cell

search.structured.max_items_per_cell.description: Maximum number of items to extract per dimension cell.
search.structured.max_items_per_cell.name: Max Items Per Cell

search.structured.max_cells.description: Maximum total cells to research. Prevents runaway costs from large dimension trees.
search.structured.max_cells.name: Max Total Cells

search.structured.cross_cell_context.description: Pass findings from earlier cells as context to later cells. Improves accuracy but makes cells order-dependent.
search.structured.cross_cell_context.name: Cross-Cell Context

search.structured.enrichment_mode.description: How child-level findings affect parent data. 'correct' flags contradictions, 'append' adds missed items, 'ignore' keeps levels independent.
search.structured.enrichment_mode.name: Enrichment Mode

search.structured.generate_summaries.description: Automatically generate a narrative summary for each top-level dimension value after research completes.
search.structured.generate_summaries.name: Generate Dimension Summaries
